chapter.wholeRead: Complete input read1-335,336-680,681-1030,1031-1350 with1230-1350 recovered separately. Final1-490,491-990,991-1504 read, with1226-1295 recovered after truncated output. The two subsequently edited filler clauses and their full paragraphs were reread; no later chapter changes.

explanation.scope: Added33 subject links per locale,27 explicit anchors and eight descriptive image alternatives. Removed two authorial filler clauses without changing the explanations. All eleven programs,23 display derivations,30 source-unit identifiers, legacy anchors, original-source captions and eight figures retained.
explanation.mechanismReview: Whole explanation reviewed: within-prompt groups and uniform groups; signed clipping; k3 KL expectation versus semigradient; current/old/reference policies; response masks; process-step rewards and future sums; reward/length normalizations and unequal microbatches; group-mean bias/leave-one-out; Dr.GRPO/RFT/MaxRL population-versus-finite-group estimators and skipped failures; controlled ablations; pinned TRL configuration; sampling/support and stale rollouts; token/full-trajectory ratios; GSPO; R1-Zero/full R1 stages; Kimi partial rollouts, quadratic objective and length reward; Qwen3 stages; self-correction and diagnostics.

freshSourceRead.sections: DeepSeekMath v3 §4.1.1-4.1.4, Algorithm1 and §4.2; distinguishes outcome/process supervision, direct KL penalty, old/reference roles and10% RM replay.

reusedSourceReview.condition: The exact three Oct30 changes invert current input to the accepted hash; current navigation/style changes also invert exactly. Reuse is limited to unchanged explanations, equations, source sections and original figure provenance. The historical DeepSeekMath Figure4 permission warning is resolved by the Oct30 MIT RLHF Book replacement, not by borrowing another asset's license.

explanation.limits: This navigation/re-reading pass does not prove full CS336/Berkeley coverage or all153 chapters' acceptance; no new algorithm or course expansion was claimed.

style.result: Removed 'Есть и более тонкая деталь' and 'следует учитывать важную деталь'. Kept derivations, meaningful technical contrasts, numeric examples, caveats and source-native English. No translation pass.

examples.environment: First offline resolution failed because TRL was absent; pinned packages restored through the official PyPI registry. That step downloaded pandas10.7MiB and pyarrow35.6MiB plus runtime dependencies. Final command succeeded offline. No model weights, tokenizer, dataset, Trainer, GPU training or benchmark.

figures.bytes: All eight match their existing central-registry SHA256 values; no assets or licenses changed.
figures.desktop: All eight originals opened and personally inspected with source captions in1280x720 viewer.

kimi.scope: Replayed segments, stop/cut/repeat legend and both axes' edges inspected.

difficultyFigure.scope: Token groups and normalization formula/legend inspected at opposite horizontal edges.

mobile.limits: Not all eight figures individually enlarged on mobile; all eight viewed on desktop and two complex originals enlarged/panned on mobile.

navigation.rendered: All33 subject anchors and links checked in both built locale routes.
navigation.actual: RU reference -> group-mean/leave-one-out explanation; EN reference -> Kimi quadratic objective; actual Next -> reasoning distillation in each locale. English canonical-language notice verified, not counted as a new English chapter. RU restored; deliverable tab retained.

receipt.scope: Current GRPO, RLVR and DPO preservation plus whole-owner receipts; overlaps the earlier17 scoped tests.
